observations.body: At God’s mountain, the bush burns without being consumed; the LORD names Israel’s affliction, sends Moses, and gives the sign of future worship at this mountain.
observations.label: Moses is called at Horeb

observations.body: Moses is called at Horeb belongs to approach to mountain in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 3:1–12 supplies antecedent evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Before the assembly

observations.body: Horeb antecedents and the approach to Sinai prepare the Event without turning every wilderness scene into the public assembly.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 3:1–12 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Moses is called at Horeb prepares for the mountain encounter, but this passage does not yet contain the public covenant assembly.
payload.title: Moses is called at Horeb
